category_name: To one who intends to give food or drink
title: Dua when intending to give food or drink
arabic: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سَقاني
transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ'im man aṭ'amanī wasqi man saqānī.
translation: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
tags: To one who intends to give food or drink
